reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING EXPERIENCE!
reviews.text:
At first I thought this app seemed too good to be true…get gifts worth money just for chatting? Not bad. But after some time of using Meete, I was suddenly banned without any warning. Looking back, it was honestly a blessing in disguise.

The issue is the user base. The quality of the community is extremely low, and it’s not worth spending hours chatting for only a few cents. There are a lot of men who behave in creepy and inappropriate ways, men who clearly prefer very young looking girls, men who make explicit requests, and men who are just flat out disrespectful.

The app itself constantly glitches, crashes, and moves slow. Verification can get revoked for adding photos that have a different makeup look or hair color than your original, forcing you to re-verify your identity all over again. 
If you ask for or share socials outside the app, you risk losing your account. And once you’re banned, any remaining earnings are gone.

If you’re a man looking for a real connection, this isn’t the place, it’s not a dating app at all. If you’re a woman considering it as a way to earn, don’t waste your time. There are much better options out there. All money isn’t good money.
